title: Dense Deployment Scaling (multi-DODAG + adaptive announces)
description: Protocol scaling for 500-8000 node deployments (DEF CON, Burning Man, urban). Two pieces: (1) density-adaptive announce parameters that reduce flooding at scale, (2) multi-DODAG deployment architecture with BR partitioning and Yggdrasil backbone. Spec changes in 05-routing.md §9.4 (adaptive parameters), §9.10 (multi-DODAG architecture), 02a-coordinated-capacity.md (SelectChannel density threshold note). Also includes future work: raising the CH0 fallback threshold.
